legal.privacyLead: Seatize takes food orders at a venue. This page says what a phone stores with us, and why.
legal.termsLead: These terms cover ordering through the app. The venue still makes and hands over the food.
legal.venuesLead: A note for venues. Fans do not create an account.

privacySections.heading: Who we are
privacySections.body: The app is run for the venue you are ordering from. Write to support@seatize.com for privacy questions.

privacySections.heading: What we store about a fan
privacySections.body: Your seat, the items, the time, the amount, and an email only if you ask for a receipt. A random id on this phone lets you see your own orders. Fans do not create an account.

privacySections.heading: Payments
privacySections.body: Card numbers are handled by Stripe. We store the result, the amount and a Stripe reference, not the full card number.

privacySections.heading: How long
privacySections.body: Orders stay so the venue can reconcile a match. After 12 months the seat, email and notes are removed. Totals stay for the books. Staff accounts stay while the person works at the venue, and can be deleted from Admin → Team.

termsSections.heading: Ordering
termsSections.body: Placing an order is an offer to buy those items from the venue. The kitchen can decline it. If it does, the charge is refunded.

termsSections.heading: Prices
termsSections.body: Prices are the venue’s, in the venue’s currency, as shown on the menu when you pay.

termsSections.heading: Allergies
termsSections.body: Notes you add are passed to the kitchen. The venue decides whether it can prepare the order safely.

termsSections.heading: The service
termsSections.body: A paused kitchen, a failed payment or a lost connection can stop an order. You are charged only when a payment succeeds.

venueSections.heading: Fans
venueSections.body: A fan order stores the seat, the lines, the time, the amount and an optional receipt email. A random device id ties that phone to its history. There is no fan account and no password.

venueSections.heading: Staff
venueSections.body: Desk accounts store name, email and role. The person can download that data or delete the account from Admin → Team, unless they are the only admin.

venueSections.heading: Retention
venueSections.body: A nightly job removes seat, email and notes from orders older than 12 months (or RECEIPT_RETENTION_DAYS). Payment totals and order numbers stay so a match can still be reconciled. Stripe keeps card data under its own terms.

security.title: Two-factor sign-in
security.setupLead: Add an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy). You'll enter a code from it each time you sign in.
security.requiredLead: Admins and Managers must use two-factor sign-in. Set it up to open the desk.
security.scanLead: Scan this code, then enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
security.codesLead: If you lose your phone, each code signs you in once. Keep them somewhere safe. They are not shown again.
security.backupFileTitle: Seat Service backup codes. Each works once.
security.manageLead: Enter your password to make a new set of backup codes. The old ones stop working.
security.lockedNote: Admins and Managers can't turn this off. If you lose your phone, ask an admin to reset it in Admin → Team.
